input.sql:
SELECT c_eye.colour AS eye_color, COUNT(s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c_eye.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC
